questions.question: What is the mood of much of Psalm 60?
options: A glad hymn of thanksgiving after a great victory
A lament after a military defeat, pleading for help
A song of ascent sung for the long, hard pilgrim journey
A solemn meditation on the great brevity of life
questions.answer: A lament after a military defeat, pleading for help

questions.question: What does the psalm conclude about salvation by man?
options: Better is a little with the fear of the LORD
Sweet is the sleep of the weary laborer who fully trusts the LORD
Precious is the death of the saints in his sight
Vain is the salvation of man; with God we shall do valiantly
questions.answer: Vain is the salvation of man; with God we shall do valiantly

questions.question: The psalm says God has given a banner to those who fear him.
With God we will do valiantly; it is He who will trample our _____.
Give us aid against the enemy, for the _____ of man is worthless.
